added.member: CSS display: list-item on text and <summary>
added.summary:
A text-only element such as a

or with display: list-item draws a ::marker too: outside before its first line, or inside as the first run of its text in the ::marker's style.

is a list item in the UA sheet (HTML §15.3.12): its marker is disclosure-closed, or disclosure-open while its
is open, and list-style restyles or removes it. The disclosure-closed and disclosure-open styles draw the theme's disclosure chevron on any list item. The summary is now an element of the details' header, so its own rules (summary, summary::marker, details[open] > summary) style it.
